scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter units build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter units build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter units build && vitest run src
scripts.schema:generate: corepack pnpm --filter project-model build && node scripts/generate-schema.mjs
scripts.schema:check: corepack pnpm --filter project-model build && node scripts/check-schema.mjs
